content.value: a. (i) Differentiate between centre of mass and centroid. (ii) State and explain the (12) Pappus and Guldiness theorem.
b. Show that the centroid of a right circular cone is on the axis at a distance of 3h/4 from the vertex.

C. The equation of an ellipse is $\mathbf { x } ^ { 2 } / 2 5 + \mathbf { y } ^ { 2 } / 1 6 = 1$ . Locate by integration the centroid (13) of that part of the area of this ellipse which falls in the first quadrant.
